lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a structured grid posterior to the gill slits, comprising approximately five distinct horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, acting as anchor nodes where the highest luminance maxima are localized.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight along the superior edge and a narrow band of shadow along the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs within the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily concentrated along the lower two-thirds of the fin's lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or irregular indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; minor irregularities in pixel continuity are noted on the distal margin of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-frequency distribution of minute, stippled high-luminance points is concentrated on the rostrum and cephalic region anterior to the gill slits.
